name: .284 Cal-140gr Absolute Hammer™

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "G7-BC= .225 calculated from shot drops" (calculated from shot drops).

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "We tested this 140gr Absolute Hammer™ in my personal 280ai with a 22″ barrel. My previous load was with the 143gr Hammer Hunter™ at a velocity of 3126 fps. The 140gr Absolute Hammer™ load settled in at 3387 fps. This is exceptional from a short barreled rifle. Absolute Hammer™s do not line up with conventional load data so they should be used by experience hand loaders only."

sources.note: https://hammerbullets.com/product/284-cal-140gr-absolute-hammer/: Recommended minimum twist rate is 1-9.25″ | Bullet length is 1.375″ | Bullet weight is 140gr | Nose length is .789″ | Recommended use: Big Game Hunting | G7-BC= .225 calculated from shot drops
